name: Pulse Music v3.2.8 - Listen Healthy, Smart Discovery, Continuous Playback & Unified com.pulse.music
body:
# Pulse Music v3.2.8 - Listen Healthy, Smart Discovery, Continuous Playback & Unified com.pulse.music

Official multi-platform release and OTA update for **Android**, **Windows**, **Orion Store**, and **Obtainium**.

---

### 🛡️ Listen Healthy & Hearing Protection (WHO 85dB)
- **Safe Volume Limiter**: Built-in 85dB safe volume limiter automatically capping headphone output at 75% to prevent long-term hearing fatigue and acoustic damage.
- **Continuous Exposure Safety Monitor**: Real-time listening session tracking displaying active safety badges (**SAFE**, **MODERATE**, **BREAK NEEDED**).
- **Ear Fatigue Break Reminders**: Customizable interval alerts (30m, 45m, 60m, 90m, 120m) reminding you to give your ears a short break.

### 🧭 Song Discovery & Smart Radio Mix
- **Discovery Mix Slider**: Dynamic balance slider in Settings and Queue sheet allowing you to adjust the blend between familiar favorites and new recommendations (0% familiar to 100% explore).
- **Quick Picks Discovery Toggle**: Live Discovery ratio badge on Home Quick Picks header allowing quick preset toggling (20%, 50%, 100% Discover) on tap.

### ⚡ Total Freeze & Reopen Lockup Elimination
- **Room Flow Deadlock Resolution**: Replaced all blocking terminal operations on continuous reactive database flows with non-blocking stream access across all media handlers, background workers, and view models.
- **Continuous Zero-Lock Playback**: Eliminates playback lockup after 1+ hours of listening and resolves app reopen freezes permanently.
- **Clean Service Unbinding**: ServiceConnection cleanly unbinds on activity termination to eliminate memory leaks.

### 🌐 Unified Package Architecture
- **Official Package Rebranding**: Full migration of package namespace and directory tree to com.pulse.music across all UI, settings, UX, and app layers.

### 🎨 Visual & Lyrics Polish
- **Dynamic Ambient Light Harmonized with Album Art**: Ambient glow accurately extracts palette colors from high-resolution album artwork.
- **Multilingual Grapheme Cluster Light**: Letter-by-letter and syllable-by-syllable smooth progressive light for all global scripts (Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Malayalam, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, Arabic, Latin).
- **Mini Capsule Lyrics Polish**: Clean floating mini capsule lyrics without elapsed timestamp clutter.
- **Settings Theme Engine**: Instant reliable switching between Dark AMOLED (#000000), Pure Light, System Default, and Pastel Pearl Lavender.
- **Settings Footer Attribution**: Added 'Designed & Developed by Manikandan'.
